verses.modern: Yet the people of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maachathites, but Geshur and Maacath dwell in the midst of Israel to this day.

verses.kjv: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.modern: To the tribe of Levi alone Moses gave no inheritance. The offerings made by fire to the LORD God of Israel are their inheritance, as He said to them.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
verses.modern: Moses gave an inheritance to the tribe of the people of Reuben according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.modern: Their territory was from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

verses.kjv: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon,
verses.modern: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

verses.kjv: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.modern: Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

verses.kjv: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
verses.modern: Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar on the hill of the valley,

verses.kjv: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,
verses.modern: Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

verses.kjv: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
verses.modern: that is, all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses defeated with the leaders of Midian, Evi and Rekem and Zur and Hur and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

verses.kjv: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
verses.modern: Balaam also, the son of Beor, the one who practiced divination, was killed with the sword by the people of Israel among the rest of their slain.

verses.kjv: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.modern: the boundary of the people of Reuben was the Jordan as a boundary. This was the inheritance of the people of Reuben, according to their clans with their cities and villages.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.modern: Moses gave an inheritance to the tribe of Gad, to the people of Gad, according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.modern: Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites, to Aroer, which is east of Rabbah,

verses.kjv: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
verses.modern: from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir,

verses.kjv: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
verses.modern: in the valley Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, with the Jordan as a boundary, to the lower end of the Sea of Chinnereth, eastward beyond the Jordan.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
verses.modern: This is the inheritance of the people of Gad according to their clans, with their cities and villages.

verses.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
verses.modern: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was allotted to the half-tribe of the people of Manasseh according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
verses.modern: Their territory extended from Mahanaim, through all Bashan, the whole kingdom of Og king of Bashan. All the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities,

verses.kjv: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
verses.modern: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan. These were allotted to the people of Machir the son of Manasseh for the half of the people of Machir according to their clans.

verses.kjv: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
verses.modern: These are the inheritances that Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan east of Jericho.

verses.kjv: But unto the tribe of Levi, Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
verses.modern: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance; the LORD God of Israel is their inheritance, just as He said to them.

chapters.summary: God told the aging Joshua that much land remained to be possessed and commanded him to divide it among the nine and a half tribes. The territories of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan are described, and the tribe of Levi received no land inheritance.

verses.kjv: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
verses.modern: These are the inheritances that the people of Israel received in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the people of Israel gave them to inherit.

verses.kjv: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
verses.modern: Their inheritance was by lot, just as the LORD had commanded through Moses, for the nine and a half tribes.

verses.kjv: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
verses.modern: For Moses had given an inheritance to the two and a half tribes beyond the Jordan, but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

verses.kjv: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
verses.modern: For the people of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And no portion was given to the Levites in the land, but only cities to live in, with their pasturelands for their livestock and their substance.

verses.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.modern: The people of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses; they allotted the land.

verses.kjv: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
verses.modern: Then the people of Judah came to Joshua at Gilgal. And Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said to him, "You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God in Kadesh-barnea concerning you and me.

verses.kjv: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
verses.modern: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land. I brought Him word again as it was in my heart.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
verses.modern: But my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; yet I wholly followed the LORD my God.

verses.kjv: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.
verses.modern: Moses swore on that day, saying, 'Surely the land on which Your foot has trodden shall be an inheritance for You and Your children forever, because You have wholly followed the LORD my God.'

verses.kjv: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
verses.modern: now, the LORD has kept me alive, just as He said, these forty-five years since the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. And now, I am this day eighty-five years old.

verses.kjv: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
verses.modern: I am still as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me; my strength now is as my strength was then, for war and for going and coming.

verses.kjv: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
verses.modern: So now give me this hill country of which the LORD spoke on that day, for You heard on that day how the Anakim were there, with great fortified cities. It may be that the LORD will be with me. I shall drive them out just as the LORD said."

verses.kjv: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
verses.modern: Then Joshua blessed him. He gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

verses.kjv: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.
verses.modern: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite to this day, because He wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
verses.modern: Now the name of Hebron formerly was Kiriath-arba. (Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim.) And the land had rest from war.

chapters.summary: The land of Canaan was distributed by lot at Gilgal under the oversight of Eleazar and Joshua. Caleb, now eighty-five years old and still strong, claimed Hebron as his inheritance because he had wholly followed the LORD.

verses.kjv: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
verses.modern: The allotment for the tribe of the people of Judah according to their clans reached southward to the boundary of Edom, to the wilderness of Zin at the farthest south.

verses.kjv: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
verses.modern: their south boundary ran from the end of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward.

verses.kjv: And it went out to the south side to Maalehakrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
verses.modern: It goes out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, passes along to Zin, and goes up south of Kadesh-barnea, along by Hezron, up to Addar, turns about to Karka,

verses.kjv: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
verses.modern: passes along to Azmon, goes out by the Brook of Egypt, and comes to its end at the sea. This shall be your south boundary.

verses.kjv: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
verses.modern: the east boundary is the Salt Sea, to the mouth of the Jordan. And the boundary on the north side runs from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
verses.modern: the boundary goes up to Beth-hoglah and passes along north of Beth-arabah. And the boundary goes up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

verses.kjv: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:
verses.modern: the boundary goes up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, and so northward, turning toward Gilgal, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the valley. And the boundary passes along to the waters of En-shemesh and ends at En-rogel.

verses.kjv: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
verses.modern: Then the boundary goes up by the Valley of the Son of Hinnom at the southern shoulder of the Jebusite (that is, Jerusalem). And the boundary goes up to the top of the mountain that lies over against the Valley of Hinnom, on the west, at the northern end of the valley of the giants.

verses.kjv: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:
verses.modern: Then the boundary extends from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and from there to the cities of Mount Ephron. Then the boundary bends around to Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).

verses.kjv: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
verses.modern: the boundary circles west of Baalah to Mount Seir, passes along to the northern shoulder of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), and goes down to Beth-shemesh and passes along by Timnah.

verses.kjv: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.modern: The boundary goes out to the shoulder of the hill north of Ekron, then the boundary bends around to Shikkeron and passes along to Mount Baalah and goes out to Jabneel. Then the boundary comes to an end at the sea.

verses.kjv: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.modern: the west boundary was the Great Sea with its coastline. This is the boundary around the people of Judah according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
verses.modern: According to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, he gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the people of Judah, Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron (Arba was the father of Anak).

verses.kjv: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.modern: Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak, Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai, the descendants of Anak.

verses.kjv: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
verses.modern: he went up from there against the inhabitants of Debir. Now the name of Debir formerly was Kiriath-sepher.

verses.kjv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.modern: Caleb said, "Whoever strikes Kiriath-sepher and captures it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife."

verses.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.modern: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, captured it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
verses.modern: When she came to him, she urged him to ask her father for a field. And she got off her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you want?"

verses.kjv: She answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
verses.modern: She said to him, "Give me a blessing. Since you have given me a south land, give me also springs of water." And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.modern: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Judah according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
verses.modern: The cities belonging to the tribe of the people of Judah in the extreme south, toward the boundary of Edom, were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

verses.kjv: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
verses.modern: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

verses.kjv: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
verses.modern: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

verses.kjv: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
verses.modern: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

verses.kjv: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
verses.modern: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (that is, Hazor),

verses.kjv: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
verses.modern: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

verses.kjv: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
verses.modern: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,

verses.kjv: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
verses.modern: Hazar-shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

verses.kjv: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
verses.modern: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

verses.kjv: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
verses.modern: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

verses.kjv: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
verses.modern: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

verses.kjv: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
verses.modern: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon: in all, twenty-nine cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
verses.modern: in the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

verses.kjv: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
verses.modern: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

verses.kjv: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
verses.modern: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

verses.kjv: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, Gederothaim: fourteen cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
verses.modern: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,

verses.kjv: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
verses.modern: Dilean, Mizpeh, Joktheel,

verses.kjv: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
verses.modern: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

verses.kjv: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
verses.modern: Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish,

verses.kjv: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah: sixteen cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
verses.modern: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

verses.kjv: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
verses.modern: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

verses.kjv: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah: nine cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
verses.modern: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

verses.kjv: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
verses.modern: from Ekron to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

verses.kjv: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
verses.modern: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the Brook of Egypt, and the Great Sea with its coastline.

verses.kjv: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
verses.modern: in the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

verses.kjv: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
verses.modern: Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (that is, Debir),

verses.kjv: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
verses.modern: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

verses.kjv: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh: eleven cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
verses.modern: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

verses.kjv: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,
verses.modern: Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,

verses.kjv: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Humtah, Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior: nine cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
verses.modern: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,

verses.kjv: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
verses.modern: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

verses.kjv: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah: ten cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
verses.modern: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,

verses.kjv: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon: six cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah: two cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.modern: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,

verses.kjv: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.modern: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi: six cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.modern: But the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the people of Judah could not drive out, so the Jebusites dwell with the people of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

chapters.summary: The boundaries and cities of the territory allotted to the tribe of Judah are detailed, stretching from Edom in the south to the Mediterranean. Caleb drove out the Anakim from Hebron, and Othniel captured Kiriath-sepher to win Caleb's daughter Achsah; the Jebusites in Jerusalem could not be driven out.

verses.kjv: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,
verses.modern: The allotment of the people of Joseph went from the Jordan by Jericho, east of the waters of Jericho, into the wilderness, going up from Jericho into the hill country to Bethel.

verses.kjv: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
verses.modern: Then going from Bethel to Luz, it passes along to Ataroth, the territory of the Archites.

verses.kjv: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
verses.modern: Then it goes down westward to the territory of the Japhletites, as far as the territory of Lower Beth-horon, then to Gezer. It ends at the sea.

verses.kjv: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.modern: The people of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.

verses.kjv: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
verses.modern: The territory of the people of Ephraim by their clans was as follows: the boundary of their inheritance on the east was Ataroth-addar as far as Upper Beth-horon,

verses.kjv: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
verses.modern: the boundary goes from there to the sea. On the north is Michmethath. Then on the east the boundary turns around toward Taanath-shiloh and passes along beyond it on the east to Janoah,

verses.kjv: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
verses.modern: then it goes down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, and touches Jericho, ending at the Jordan.

verses.kjv: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
verses.modern: From Tappuah the boundary goes westward to the brook Kanah and ends at the sea. Such is the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Ephraim by their clans,

verses.kjv: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.modern: together with the towns that were set apart for the people of Ephraim within the inheritance of the people of Manasseh, all those towns with their villages.

verses.kjv: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
verses.modern: However, they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day but have been made to do forced labor.

chapters.summary: The allotment for Ephraim is described, with boundaries from Ataroth-addar to the brook Kanah. The Canaanites in Gezer were not driven out but were put to forced labor.

verses.kjv: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.modern: Then allotment was made to the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. To Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, were allotted Gilead and Bashan, because he was a man of war.

verses.kjv: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
verses.modern: allotments were made to the rest of the people of Manasseh by their clans, Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These were the male descendants of Manasseh the son of Joseph, by their clans.

verses.kjv: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.modern: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters, and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.kjv: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.modern: They approached Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the leaders and said, "The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance along with our brothers." So according to the mouth of the LORD He gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

verses.kjv: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
verses.modern: Thus there fell to Manasseh ten portions, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is on the other side of the Jordan,

verses.kjv: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
verses.modern: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance along with his sons. The land of Gilead was allotted to the rest of the people of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
verses.modern: The territory of Manasseh reached from Asher to Michmethath, which is east of Shechem. Then the boundary goes along southward to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

verses.kjv: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
verses.modern: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but the town of Tappuah on the boundary of Manasseh belonged to the people of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
verses.modern: Then the boundary goes down to the brook Kanah. These cities, to the south of the brook, among the cities of Manasseh, belong to Ephraim. Then the boundary of Manasseh goes along the north side of the brook and ends at the sea,

verses.kjv: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
verses.modern: the land to the south being Ephraim's and that to the north being Manasseh's, with the sea forming its boundary. On the north Asher is reached, and on the east Issachar.

verses.kjv: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
verses.modern: Also in Issachar and in Asher, Manasseh had Beth-shean and its villages, Ibleam and its villages, the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, the inhabitants of En-dor and its villages, the inhabitants of Taanach and its villages, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages; three countries.

verses.kjv: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.modern: Yet the people of Manasseh could not take possession of those cities, but the Canaanites persisted in dwelling in that land.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.modern: When the people of Israel grew strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not utterly drive them out.

verses.kjv: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?
verses.modern: Then the people of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given me but one lot and one portion as an inheritance, although I am a numerous people, since all along the LORD has blessed me?"

verses.kjv: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
verses.modern: Joshua said to them, "If you are a numerous people, go up by yourselves to the forest, and there clear ground for yourselves in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you."

verses.kjv: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
verses.modern: The people of Joseph said, "The hill country is not enough for us. Yet all the Canaanites who dwell in the plain have chariots of iron, both those in Beth-shean and its villages and those in the Valley of Jezreel."

verses.kjv: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
verses.modern: Then Joshua said to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, "You are a numerous people and have great power. You shall not have one allotment only,

verses.kjv: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
verses.modern: but the hill country shall be yours, for though it is a forest, you shall clear it and possess it to its farthest borders. For you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots and though they are strong."

chapters.summary: The territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh west of the Jordan is described, including the inheritance granted to the daughters of Zelophehad. The people of Joseph complained that their allotment was too small, and Joshua told them to clear the forested hill country.

verses.kjv: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
verses.modern: Then the whole congregation of the people of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there. The land lay subdued before them.

verses.kjv: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.modern: There remained among the people of Israel seven tribes whose inheritance had not yet been apportioned.

verses.kjv: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
verses.modern: So Joshua said to the people of Israel, "How long will you put off going in to take possession of the land, which the LORD, the God of Your fathers, has given You?

verses.kjv: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
verses.modern: Provide three men from each tribe. I will send them out that they may set out and go up and down the land. They shall write a description of it with a view to their inheritances, and then come to me.

verses.kjv: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
verses.modern: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall continue in his territory on the south, and the house of Joseph shall continue in their territory on the north.

verses.kjv: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
verses.modern: you shall describe the land in seven divisions and bring the description here to me. And I will cast lots for You here before the LORD our God.

verses.kjv: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.
verses.modern: The Levites have no portion among You, for the priesthood of the LORD is their heritage. And Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan eastward, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them."

verses.kjv: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.
verses.modern: So the men arose and went, and Joshua charged those who went to write the description of the land, saying, "Go up and down in the land and write a description and return to me. And I will cast lots for You here before the LORD in Shiloh."

verses.kjv: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
verses.modern: So the men went and passed up and down in the land and wrote in a book a description of it by towns in seven divisions. Then they came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh,

verses.kjv: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.modern: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. And there Joshua apportioned the land to the people of Israel, to each his portion.

verses.kjv: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.modern: The lot of the tribe of the people of Benjamin according to its clans came up, and the territory allotted to it fell between the people of Judah and the people of Joseph.

verses.kjv: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
verses.modern: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan. Then the boundary goes up to the shoulder north of Jericho, then up through the hill country westward. It ends at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

verses.kjv: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
verses.modern: From there the boundary passes along southward in the direction of Luz, to the shoulder of Luz (that is, Bethel), then the boundary goes down to Ataroth-addar, on the mountain that lies south of Lower Beth-horon.

verses.kjv: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
verses.modern: Then the boundary goes in another direction, turning on the west side southward from the mountain that lies to the south, opposite Beth-horon. It ends at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the people of Judah. This forms the western side.

verses.kjv: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
verses.modern: the south side begins at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim. And the boundary goes from there to Ephron, to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

verses.kjv: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,
verses.modern: Then the boundary goes down to the border of the mountain that overlooks the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, which is at the north end of the valley of the giants. And it then goes down the Valley of Hinnom, south of the shoulder of the Jebusites, and downward to En-rogel.

verses.kjv: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.modern: Then it bends in a northerly direction going on to En-shemesh, and from there goes to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. Then it goes down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

verses.kjv: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
verses.modern: passing on to the north side of the shoulder of Beth-arabah, it goes down to the Arabah.

verses.kjv: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
verses.modern: Then the boundary passes on to the north shoulder of Beth-hoglah. And the boundary ends at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan: this is the southern boundary.

verses.kjv: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.modern: The Jordan forms its boundary on the east side. This is the inheritance of the people of Benjamin, according to their clans, boundary by boundary all around.

verses.kjv: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
verses.modern: Now the cities of the tribe of the people of Benjamin according to their clans were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,

verses.kjv: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
verses.modern: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

verses.kjv: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
verses.modern: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

verses.kjv: And Chepharhammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.modern: Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, Geba—twelve cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
verses.modern: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

verses.kjv: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
verses.modern: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

verses.kjv: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
verses.modern: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

verses.kjv: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.modern: Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath-jearim—fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the people of Benjamin according to their clans.

chapters.summary: The tabernacle was set up at Shiloh, and Joshua sent surveyors to map the remaining land into seven portions. The territory of Benjamin was allotted by lot, situated between Judah and Joseph.

verses.kjv: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.modern: The second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the people of Simeon, according to their clans. Their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the people of Judah.

verses.kjv: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,
verses.modern: they had for their inheritance Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,

verses.kjv: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,
verses.modern: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,

verses.kjv: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
verses.modern: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

verses.kjv: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
verses.modern: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah,

verses.kjv: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
verses.modern: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen—thirteen cities with their villages;

verses.kjv: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
verses.modern: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—four cities with their villages;

verses.kjv: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.modern: together with all the villages around these cities as far as Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Simeon according to their clans.

verses.kjv: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
verses.modern: The inheritance of the people of Simeon formed part of the territory of the people of Judah. Because the portion of the people of Judah was too large for them, the people of Simeon obtained an inheritance in the midst of their inheritance.

verses.kjv: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid.
verses.modern: The third lot came up for the people of Zebulun, according to their clans. And the boundary of their inheritance reached as far as Sarid.

verses.kjv: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
verses.modern: Their border went up westward toward Maralah and reached as far as Dabbesheth, then reached the brook that is before Jokneam.

verses.kjv: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
verses.modern: From Sarid it turned eastward toward the sunrising to the border of Chisloth-tabor, then went out to Daberath and up to Japhia.

verses.kjv: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;
verses.modern: From there it passed along on the east to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and went out to Rimmon, bending toward Neah.

verses.kjv: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
verses.modern: The border circled around it on the north to Hannathon, and ended in the valley of Iphtahel.

verses.kjv: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
verses.modern: It also included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem — twelve cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.modern: This was the inheritance of the people of Zebulun according to their clans — these cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.modern: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, for the people of Issachar, according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
verses.modern: Their territory included Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

verses.kjv: And Hapharaim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,
verses.modern: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

verses.kjv: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
verses.modern: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

verses.kjv: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;
verses.modern: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

verses.kjv: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.modern: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and ended at the Jordan — sixteen cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.modern: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Issachar, according to their clans — the cities and their villages.

verses.kjv: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.modern: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the people of Asher according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
verses.modern: Their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

verses.kjv: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;
verses.modern: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal; and it reached to Carmel on the west and to Shihor-libnath.

verses.kjv: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.modern: Then it turned toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon and reached to Zebulun and to the valley of Iphtahel northward to Beth-emek and Neiel, then went out to Cabul on the north,

verses.kjv: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
verses.modern: with Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as great Zidon.

verses.kjv: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
verses.modern: Then the boundary turned to Ramah and to the fortified city of Tyre, and turned to Hosah, ending at the sea in the region of Achzib,

verses.kjv: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
verses.modern: Ummah also, Aphek, and Rehob — twenty-two cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.modern: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Asher, according to their clans — these cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.modern: The sixth lot came out for the people of Naphtali, for the people of Naphtali, according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
verses.modern: Their border ran from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and from Adami-nekeb and Jabneel as far as Lakkum, ending at the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.modern: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and went out from there to Hukkok, reaching to Zebulun on the south, to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrising.

verses.kjv: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
verses.modern: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

verses.kjv: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
verses.modern: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

verses.kjv: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,
verses.modern: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,

verses.kjv: And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.modern: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh — nineteen cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.modern: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Naphtali, according to their clans — the cities and their villages.

verses.kjv: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.modern: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the people of Dan, according to their clans.

verses.kjv: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,
verses.modern: The territory of their inheritance included Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,

verses.kjv: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
verses.modern: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

verses.kjv: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
verses.modern: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

verses.kjv: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
verses.modern: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

verses.kjv: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,
verses.modern: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,

verses.kjv: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
verses.modern: Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the territory over against Joppa.

verses.kjv: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.modern: When the territory of the people of Dan was lost to them, the people of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and after capturing it and striking it with the sword they possessed it and settled in it, calling Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor.

verses.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.modern: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Dan, according to their clans—these cities with their villages.

verses.kjv: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
verses.modern: When they had finished distributing the several territories of the land as inheritances, the people of Israel gave an inheritance among them to Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
verses.modern: By command of the LORD they gave Him the city that He asked, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And He rebuilt the city and lived in it.

verses.kjv: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
verses.modern: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the people of Israel distributed by lot at Shiloh before the LORD, at the entrance of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

chapters.summary: The remaining six tribes—Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Dan—received their allotments by lot. Joshua himself received the city of Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to Joshua,

verses.kjv: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:
verses.modern: "Say to the people of Israel, 'Appoint the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you through Moses,

verses.kjv: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
verses.modern: that the manslayer who strikes any person without intent or unknowingly may flee there. They shall be for you a refuge from the avenger of blood.

verses.kjv: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
verses.modern: He shall flee to one of these cities and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city and explain his case to the elders of that city. Then they shall take him into the city and give him a place. He shall remain with them.

verses.kjv: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.
verses.modern: if the avenger of blood pursues him, they shall not give up the manslayer into his hand, because he struck his neighbor unknowingly, and did not hate him in the past.

verses.kjv: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.
verses.modern: he shall remain in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of him who is high priest at the time. Then the manslayer may return to his own town and his own home, to the town from which he fled.' "

verses.kjv: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.
verses.modern: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

verses.kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.modern: beyond the Jordan east of Jericho, they appointed Bezer in the wilderness on the tableland, from the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead, from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan, from the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
verses.modern: These were the cities designated for all the people of Israel and for the stranger sojourning among them, that anyone who killed a person without intent could flee there, so that he might not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, till he stood before the congregation.

chapters.summary: Six cities of refuge were designated—three west of the Jordan and three east—where anyone who killed a person accidentally could flee and be safe from the avenger of blood.

verses.kjv: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
verses.modern: Then the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua the son of Nun and to the heads of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
verses.modern: they said to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, "The LORD commanded through Moses that we be given cities to dwell in, along with their pasturelands for our livestock."

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
verses.modern: So the people of Israel gave to the Levites, out of their inheritance, by command of the LORD, these cities and their pasturelands.

verses.kjv: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.modern: The lot came out for the clans of the Kohathites. So those Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest received by lot thirteen cities from the tribe of Judah, the tribe of Simeon, and the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.modern: the rest of the Kohathites received by lot from the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, from the tribe of Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

verses.kjv: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.modern: The Gershonites received by lot from the clans of the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.kjv: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.modern: The Merarites according to their clans received from the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: These cities and their pasturelands the people of Israel gave by lot to the Levites, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

verses.kjv: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
verses.modern: Out of the tribe of the people of Judah and out of the tribe of the people of Simeon they gave these cities which are mentioned by name,

verses.kjv: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
verses.modern: which went to the descendants of Aaron of the clans of the Kohathites, who were of the people of Levi, for theirs was the first lot.

verses.kjv: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.modern: They gave them Kiriath-arba (Arba being the father of Anak), that is, Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the pasturelands around it.

verses.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.modern: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as his possession.

verses.kjv: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Thus they gave to the descendants of Aaron the priest Hebron with its pasturelands, the city of refuge for the slayer, and Libnah with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Jattir with its pasturelands, Eshtemoa with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Holon with its pasturelands, Debir with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.modern: Ain with its pasturelands, Juttah with its pasturelands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasturelands — nine cities out of those two tribes.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Out of the tribe of Benjamin: Gibeon with its pasturelands, Geba with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.modern: Anathoth with its pasturelands, and Almon with its pasturelands — four cities.

verses.kjv: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.modern: The cities of the descendants of Aaron the priests were thirteen in all, with their pasturelands.

verses.kjv: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.modern: The clans of the Kohathites — the Levites who remained of the Kohathites — received the cities of their lot from the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.modern: They gave them Shechem with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the slayer, and Gezer with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.modern: Kibzaim with its pasturelands, and Beth-horon with its pasturelands — four cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Out of the tribe of Dan: Elteke with its pasturelands, Gibbethon with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.modern: Aijalon with its pasturelands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands — four cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.modern: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Taanach with its pasturelands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands — two cities.

verses.kjv: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
verses.modern: All the cities of the remaining clans of the Kohathites were ten, with their pasturelands.

verses.kjv: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.
verses.modern: To the Gershonites, one of the clans of the Levites, out of the other half-tribe of Manasseh, they gave Golan in Bashan with its pasturelands, the city of refuge for the slayer, and Beeshterah with its pasturelands — two cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Out of the tribe of Issachar: Kishion with its pasturelands, Daberath with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.modern: Jarmuth with its pasturelands, and En-gannim with its pasturelands — four cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Out of the tribe of Asher: Mishal with its pasturelands, Abdon with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.modern: Helkath with its pasturelands, and Rehob with its pasturelands — four cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
verses.modern: Out of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands, the city of refuge for the slayer, Hammoth-dor with its pasturelands, and Kartan with its pasturelands — three cities.

verses.kjv: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
verses.modern: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their clans were thirteen, with their pasturelands.

verses.kjv: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
verses.modern: To the clans of the descendants of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam with its pasturelands, Kartah with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.modern: Dimnah with its pasturelands, and Nahalal with its pasturelands — four cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer with its pasturelands, Jahzah with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
verses.modern: Kedemoth with its pasturelands, and Mephaath with its pasturelands — four cities.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.modern: Out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasturelands, the city of refuge for the slayer, Mahanaim with its pasturelands,

verses.kjv: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
verses.modern: Heshbon with its pasturelands, and Jazer with its pasturelands — four cities in all.

verses.kjv: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by lot twelve cities.
verses.modern: All the cities of the descendants of Merari, according to their clans, the rest of the clans of the Levites — those allotted to them — were twelve cities in all.

verses.kjv: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
verses.modern: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the people of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasturelands.

verses.kjv: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
verses.modern: These cities each had its pasturelands around it. So it was with all these cities.

verses.kjv: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
verses.modern: Thus the LORD gave to Israel all the land that He swore to give to their fathers. And they took possession of it. They settled there.

verses.kjv: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.modern: the LORD gave them rest on every side just as He had sworn to their fathers. Not one of all their enemies had withstood them, for the LORD had given all their enemies into their hands.

verses.kjv: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
verses.modern: Not one word of all the good promises that the LORD had made to the house of Israel had failed; all came to pass.

chapters.summary: Forty-eight cities with pasturelands were given to the Levites from the territories of the other tribes. The LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to their fathers, and not one word of His promises failed.

verses.kjv: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.modern: At that time Joshua summoned the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
verses.modern: said to them, "You have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded You and have obeyed my voice in all that I have commanded You.

verses.kjv: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.
verses.modern: You have not forsaken Your brothers these many days, down to this day, but have been careful to keep the charge of the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.
verses.modern: now the LORD Your God has given rest to Your brothers, as He promised them. Therefore turn and go to Your tents in the land where Your possession lies, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave You on the other side of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.modern: Only be very careful to observe the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded You, to love the LORD Your God, and to walk in all His ways and to keep His commandments and to hold fast to Him and to serve Him with all Your heart and with all Your soul."

verses.kjv: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
verses.modern: So Joshua blessed them and sent them away. They went to their tents.

verses.kjv: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
verses.modern: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given a possession in Bashan, but to the other half Joshua had given a possession beside their brothers on the west side of the Jordan. And when Joshua sent them away to their tents and blessed them,

verses.kjv: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
verses.modern: he said to them, "Go back to your tents with much wealth and with very much livestock, with silver, gold, bronze, and iron, and with much clothing. Divide the spoil of your enemies with your brothers."

verses.kjv: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: So the people of Reuben and the people of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned home, parting from the people of Israel at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, their own land of which they had possessed themselves by command of the LORD through Moses.

verses.kjv: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
verses.modern: when they came to the region of the Jordan that is in the land of Canaan, the people of Reuben and the people of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by the Jordan, an altar of imposing size.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: the people of Israel heard it said, " the people of Reuben and the people of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built the altar at the frontier of the land of Canaan, in the region about the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the people of Israel."

verses.kjv: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
verses.modern: when the people of Israel heard of it, the whole assembly of the people of Israel gathered at Shiloh to make war against them.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
verses.modern: Then the people of Israel sent to the people of Reuben and the people of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

verses.kjv: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
verses.modern: with him ten chiefs, one from each of the tribal families of Israel, every one of them the head of a family among the clans of Israel.

verses.kjv: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
verses.modern: they came to the people of Reuben, the people of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, in the land of Gilead. They said to them,
